almostIncluded.description:
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Doubling Season.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Doubling Season
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Doubling Season.
Repeat from step 5.
almostIncluded.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.

almostIncluded.notes: Ideally, if the two creatures require different amounts of mana, you will want to start the combo with the lower cost creature in your hand. This should negate the need to start with mana. However, the opposite can be done if you provide mana (as needed) to cover the difference. An example of the prerequisite: If the creatures have total cost {3}{U}{U}, other creatures you control, after tapping two times each, must produce at least {3}{U}{U}. Therefore, if creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, they will create {4}{U}{U} after being tapped twice, and meet the prerequisite.
